title: Forecasting a lost gamble
hook: Two stated cases: explore the gap between predicted and realized emotional impact.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the gap between predicted and realized emotional impact affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Error, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the gap between predicted and realized emotional impact in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
